versions.changelog:
Initial release of csv-profiler.

- Profiles CSV and other tabular data to provide an overview of contents.
- Automatically detects delimiter, encoding, header, and reports shape.
- Classifies columns by type: numeric, datetime, categorical, boolean, or text.
- Summarizes columns with statistics (min, max, mean, value counts, etc.).
- Flags missing data, mixed types, duplicates, and outliers.
- Suggests cleaning steps and highlights potential identifier columns.
